name: codebase-design
title_zh: 深模块词汇表，接口设计前先翻它
tagline_zh: 接口画歪了才来改？不如画之前就有一份共享词汇：深模块、接缝、可测试性、AI 可导航性。
tagline_en: Sketching a seam? Before you code, get a shared lexicon: deep modules, testability, AI-navigability. Each term.
desc_en: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
why_zh: 它不给你画架构，而是给团队一套精确的词汇，让“这里该切一刀”变成可讨论、可指认的共识。
why_en: It doesn't draw architecture for you. It hands your team precise terms to name where a cut belongs, turning design hunches into.
limit_zh: 只提供词汇与判断框架，不生成具体接口代码，也不做代码分析；需要你已有模块草图或代码上下文，否则它只能泛泛而谈。
limit_en: Vocabulary and judgment only. No code generation, no repo analysis. Needs your module sketch or code context; otherwise it stays generic.
